generation.scope: For every reduced finite Frobenius window an integral eight-cofactor nodal or cuspidal kernel cannot have a finite unbranched pencil member. The normalization incidence covers even proportional conductor points. Removing constant eigenlines bounds every finite residual pencil by explicit Chern lengths, and distinct eigenlines cannot both have degree one. The reduced nodal cases left are order two and boundary, and the reduced cusp case left is boundary.

open_mathematics: Resolve the singular boundary Hankel and nodal order-two members, and extend residual estimates to nonreduced conductor fibers. Continue higher-cofactor, reducible-octic and general-window coverage.
